e7_s4_rationale: The large size of the breast mass (20 cm × 20 cm) in a premenarcheal girl, combined with ultrasonography and fine-needle aspiration cytology results suggestive of fibroadenoma, points towards a giant fibroadenoma, which is a type of fibroadenoma characterized by its large size.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Fibroadenoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: While the diagnosis is suggestive of fibroadenoma, the size of the mass is unusually large, making 'giant fibroadenoma' a more specific diagnosis.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Phyllodes tumor
e7_s4_rejected.why: Phyllodes tumors can be large but are less common in premenarcheal girls and often have a more complex ultrasonographic appearance.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Juvenile fibroadenoma
e7_s4_rejected.why: Juvenile fibroadenoma is another term sometimes used for fibroadenomas in young patients, but 'giant fibroadenoma' more accurately describes the size of the mass in this case.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Cystosarcoma phyllodes
e7_s4_rejected.why: Cystosarcoma phyllodes is an outdated term for phyllodes tumors, which are less likely given the clinical and diagnostic findings pointing more strongly towards a benign fibroadenoma.
